technical.summary: ENPH shows solid bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive momentum indicators, but overbought conditions (stoch, Williams %R) combined with weak ADX trend strength and lack of volume confirmation limit swing entry conviction.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buying from junior members 10+ months ago provides minimal conviction; market fear (41 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirming sentiment data.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (234) indicates extreme market fear, and earnings in 64 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.
